editorial.script_originality: PASS — original Hindi narration written from sourced facts; not copied or mechanically paraphrased

FSDA figures reported by multiple outlets; lab outcomes are not claimed for every seized item.
Allegations are attributed; a follow-up outlet reports DM regret, but no final inquiry result was found.
Early-season area comparison based on Agriculture Ministry figures reported by Business Standard and Daijiworld; not final crop loss.
September CPI figures supported by official PIB/MoSPI release; Reuters outlook is framed as risk, not certainty.
Two deaths and property/crop damage reported; crop estimates vary and remain preliminary.
Match result and key figures corroborated by Reuters, Hindustan Times and AP.
I4C warning is for financial institutions; script does not imply every bank customer is compromised.
Cabinet scheme supported by PM India, PIB/Ministry of Mines and Reuters; no immediate consumer price claim.
Polling-station count change is attributed to reports; no claim that voter registrations were cancelled.
FSSAI allegation and company challenge are both attributed; 6 October court relief is interim, not final; 5 November hearing outcome must be refreshed before publication.
IMD 5 November subdivision page shows no West UP warning 5–11 November; no town temperature is invented and issue time was not exposed.
